gate.scope: Current code gates; document Native/WASM parity. No full rendering parity, Office/WPS, product acceptance or release performance claim.

observations.methodology: Seven fresh processes per version/input, alternating order, workUnits=1. No fonts. Same timing probe source linked against each pinned implementation. Timers measure each step and their sum, excluding begin/input copy/take/drop/IPC and excluding clock gaps between steps. Process duration includes those and startup. Process caches empty; OS page cache and system load uncontrolled. Other stage tests completed before measurement. These are scoped diagnostics, not P95 or full product throughput, cancellation or physical resource reclamation acceptance.

latency.knownRegression: Ten thousand small objects: median sum of step times increased from 3.857616 ms to 6.040252 ms. Remains open; no quality/reference/workload relaxation.
